verdict.rationale: Mirrors documents shipping prompt and context changes to production without redeploying: corrections append system-prompt guidance and edit tool descriptions, schemas or tool-result content, and reach live agents with 'No redeploy, no code change'. Changes are previewed against stored traces before activation and can be revised or rolled back. Its scope is targeted corrections layered on the app's own prompt, not management of the base prompt itself, and versioning is only implied by revise/rollback. Missing for 10: explicit prompt version history/diffing, management of the full base prompt outside code, and independent hands-on corroboration.
